verdict.rationale: The evidence shows AvaTax calculating tax with jurisdiction-aware logic and listing transactions via API, but nothing documents a jurisdiction-level accrued-liability view, collected-versus-owed reconciliation, or GL- or accountant-ready exports. Those transaction APIs are only building blocks. Managed Returns and VAT Reporting are separate products for filing and VAT reporting, not a documented AvaTax liability report, so they are adjacent and earn no credit.

support.subject: As a finance lead, I can see accrued liability by jurisdiction at any moment — collected versus owed, filing-ready detail, and exports my accountant and GL can consume
